You are a parallel engineering worker on the ESP32-S31 openvela project. Workspace: /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela. The user explicitly requested parallel agents, prioritizing working hardware/BLE and a coherent final product demo. Read the applicable instructions and evidence. Do not access serial devices, USB/IP, flash either board, reset hardware, start heavy whole-firmware builds, edit maintained source/shared configs, edit the checklist, or modify previous evidence. The root owns board and build sequencing. Rootfs has <350 MiB free; write only to the assigned D-drive task directory. Read existing backups selectively; never recursively search all backups or the entire source tree. Do not expose credentials or dump raw private pairing material. Keep original test failures intact and distinguish separate firmware evidence from same-image integration. No publishing or communication to humans. Produce concrete reviewed files/patches and a concise result, not just an unexecuted plan. The root is building E400 cache-writeback-execution, normal korvo-smp-services with 17 ELFs. E399 started all four AppFS services then CPU0 faulted at Flash-resident esp32s31_writeback_all_locked. E400 moves exactly that helper to IRAM. Do not mutate those inputs. E398 BLE simultaneous advertising/scanning and E393 RPA pairing 20/20 passed, both single-core FLAT. Existing E166 and E159 single-core product demos are archived and verified but do not prove BLE inclusion.

Assigned output directory: /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/ble_integration

Investigate the concrete minimal path to integrate already-proven BLE into a coherent product Demo. Read the current product profiles, BLE public APIs and E346/E393/E398 evidence. Determine which BLE capabilities are actually compiled into E166/E159 and the current maintained Demo; do not infer from old tests. Prepare a minimal profile/source patch in your task directory for a usable product BLE path (scan/connect/GATT as applicable to existing UI/service APIs), with host-checkable dependency/resource evidence. Do not add unrequested UI polish or implement fake success. If real memory/configuration constraints prevent direct integration, identify precise blockers and give the smallest implementation that retains the requested real BLE functionality. Deliver a unified diff or candidate files and concise exact build/test sequence for root review. No maintained-tree edits or hardware access.

I’ll trace the maintained profiles, BLE APIs, and E346/E393/E398 evidence, then produce a task-directory-only candidate patch and an exact validation sequence. I’ll avoid hardware, maintained-tree edits, checklist/evidence mutation, and heavy builds.

Created [ble_evidence_review.md](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/ble_integration/ble_evidence_review.md) and [ble_evidence_review.json](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/ble_integration/ble_evidence_review.json).

- E346 proves two ordinary GATT cycles with real read/write/notify/readback.
- E393 proves 20/20 RPA NoIO encrypted pairing cycles.
- E398 proves simultaneous advertising/scanning and independent stops.
- All are separate single-core FLAT images; none establishes integrated Demo or SMP/Wi-Fi acceptance.
- Existing public APIs support scan/connect/discover/read/write/subscribe. Preserve scan address type and wait for actual callbacks.
- Diagnostic `write_request` really uses write-without-response.
- Generated config facts, resource budgets, hashes and precise source references are included.

No maintained-tree changes or hardware access.

Updated both evidence files with two review findings:

- E393/E398 accepted workloads have `snapshots=[]`; their command ledgers and reviews contain no free/Kmem measurements. Numeric runtime BLE overhead or minimum free heap is unsupported.
- Local API creates the service loop and Bluetooth stack inside the caller (`framework/api/bluetooth.c:31–37`); `bttool` needs no separate `bluetoothd`. Preserve one local owner.

I’ve notified `api_patch` to send its candidate for independent review. Historical acceptance remains explicitly separate from same-image product validation.

Independent review passed for both v3 profiles.

- RTC, BLE controller, wireless driver gate and H4 device now remain enabled.
- Required framework/GATT/privacy/resource settings match.
- No unsatisfied dependency warnings remain.
- Original v1 RTC and v2 wireless-gate failures are preserved.
- CMake graph, link fit and same-image hardware acceptance remain pending.

Receipts: [generated-v3-independent-review.json](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/ble_integration/generated-v3-independent-review.json) and [candidate-independent-review.json](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/ble_integration/candidate-independent-review.json).
